LuxePass — Epic 2: Location Discovery & Search
Same light design system and app shell as Phase 1 (Explore section of the member area). UI copy in English.
Permission → location → map or list → filters → edge states.

Story 2.1 · Map view: current location, En Soleil branded markers, distance in miles or km following the phone setting, zoom / pan / recentre, and a callout for the selected lounge that leads into Epic 3.
Story 2.2 · Filter drawer: amenities, distance bands, availability calendar with time band, clear all. Shared by map and list view.
Story 2.3 · List sorted by distance with thumbnails, amenity icons and availability; text search applied; infinite scroll at the bottom. Right: the loading state while data is fetched.
Edge states from the flow diagram: no results with suggestions that would bring results back (2.2), map error with retry or switch to list (2.1), and offline mode on cached lounges (2.1).
